mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that lower seizure threshold and potentiate CNS depression from clonazepam, while both drugs may cause neurological adverse effects including seizures and altered mental status.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, assess for increased CNS depression and seizure activity; adjust clonazepam dosing if necessary and consider alternative antivirals if feasible.
